oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — SEV2 — Elevated p99 latency on streaming.generate (us-east-1). Rule: service.streaming.generate.p99 > 5000ms. Incident INC-3801 paging eng-sre.

Alex: I'm on it. Noticing a sharp p99 spike starting ~13:42 UTC. p95 ~900ms, p99 ~6.2s. Streaming sessions showing tail stalls (clients see long pauses then chunked output). Dashboard: https://dash/reports/INC-3801.

Maria: Any customer impact? CS reported 3 customers with slow streaming, 1 degraded to errors. Logs show repeated "kv cache miss -> prefill -> decode wait" loops in streaming worker.

Ravi: Prom queries: `sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (shard)` shows a 6x bump on shard=gpu-17. Also `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(kv_prefill_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, shard))` jumps to >2s for the same shard. Looks like fragmentation and aggressive eviction.

Alex: Paste of relevant logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-14T13:42:08Z streaming-worker[pid=4421] WARN kv_cache: miss key=pf-23ab
2026-03-14T13:42:08Z streaming-worker[pid=4421] INFO prefill: writing 9 fragments, total_bytes=14KB
2026-03-14T13:42:09Z decode[pid=4430] DEBUG waiting_for_kv: waiting on 9 fragments
2026-03-14T13:42:10Z kv_cache: eviction triggered shard=gpu-17 reclaim=60MB
2026-03-14T13:42:10Z streaming-worker ERROR stall detected duration=1200ms
```

Ravi: Hypothesis: workload is producing many small prefill entries (short sequences, frequent prefixes) which fragment the KV store. Eviction is then thrashing decode which waits for prefill fragments. Prefill vs decode imbalance — prefill writes lots of small entries while decode expects larger contiguous caches.

Alex: Quick mitigations we can try (low risk):
- bump eviction-threshold on affected shard(s) to delay evictions
- reduce `max_prefill_fragments` to coalesce prefill writes into fewer entries
- route streaming traffic to model-legacy-1 (lower KV footprint) as temporary fallback
- enable decode-priority scheduling to favor completes over prefill writes

Sam: I'm going to pin streaming route to model-legacy-1 at 10% canary to reduce pressure. Running: `rb route update streaming --target model-legacy-1 --canary 10%`

deploy-bot: Started rollout streaming -> model-legacy-1 (canary=10%). Watch: https://deploys/release/3801

Maria: I'm increasing KV cache size on gpu-17 by 12% on the node group (rc: `kubectl patch nodegroup/gpu-17 -p '{"spec":{"kvCacheMb": +12}}'`). Applying now.

Ravi: Also applying a temporary config change to coalesce prefill fragments: `rbctl set-config kv.max_prefill_fragments=2 --shard gpu-17` (this will make prefill batch smaller in count but larger per write).

Alex: After those changes (13:51 UTC) metrics show improvement: p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.2s. Streaming stalls count down by ~85% on gpu-17. Still seeing occasional tail spikes for very long sequences (>2k tokens).

Maria: Customer impact reduced. CS updated customers; one wanted a rollback if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:

Ravi: Collected additional telemetry for root cause: many short-lived sessions (interactive chat) producing small prefill segments; KV allocator is creating many small objects leading to fragmentation and inefficient eviction scans. We'll need longer-term fixes: coalescing prefill keys, better free-list compaction, and eviction heuristics that prefer contiguous ranges.

Alex: Action items created:
- SRE-3801: Investigate KV fragmentation root cause and propose compaction strategy (owner: Ravi)
- SRE-3802: Implement prefill coalescing PR and perf test (owner: Maria)
- SRE-3803: Add decode-priority backpressure metric and runbook (owner: Alex)

Sam: Handoff note — I'll keep the mitigations (10% canary, kv size bump, max_prefill_fragments=2) for 1 hour. If metrics stay stable, we gradually rollback canary to 0% and revert node patch plan to normal scaling.

Sam: Handoff to night oncall Priya at 15:00 UTC. Priya, please monitor `service.streaming.generate.p99`, `kv_cache_evictions_total`, and `kv_prefill_latency_p95`. Revert knobs ready: `rbctl set-config kv.max_prefill_fragments=4 --shard gpu-17` and `rb route update streaming --canary 0%` are the quick rollbacks.

Priya: Ack — I'll be on watch. I'll escalate if p99 > 2s for 3 consecutive 5m windows.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-3801 status changed to: mitigated -> monitoring. Runbook link: https://runbooks/INC-3801.

Alex: Summary for postmortem: transient KV cache fragmentation due to high cardinality of short prefill writes created eviction thrash on gpu-17, causing streaming decode stalls and p99 breaches. Temporary mitigations (route fallback, cache bump, prefill coalescing config) brought latency back within SLO. Follow-ups scheduled.

Maria: I'll start the postmortem draft and attach telemetry snapshots.

Ravi: Will collect heap/fragmentation dumps from gpu-17 and add to ticket.

Priya: Monitoring handoff complete. Leaving alerts at current thresholds; escalation if recurrence.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-3801 closed to status: monitoring.
